decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper fits the firm's established construction vehicle range and serves a growing market at low incremental cost, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
The articulated construction dumper builds on core competences in rugged vehicles and rounds out the construction portfolio, so it is worth keeping.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is a substantial recent investment in an adjacent lifting segment and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
The material lift line builds on the most popular rental lift and has just won a large order, so demand is strong.
The compact underground mining loader logged 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which shows real customer use in the firm's underground niche and justifies keeping it.
